method: Nechad et al. 2009 single-band (B04 665 nm), SCL water pixels
caveat: Sen2Cor L2A leaves a large atmospheric residual over water, so a dark-pixel offset is subtracted and turbidity is RELATIVE to the clearest water in the scene. Spatial contrast is reliable; absolute metres are not. Tune k against the viz_m column in dive_log.csv.
